About us

A local family business

Classic Shed Builders LLC handcrafts sheds, garages and pavilions at our plant in Liverpool, Pennsylvania.

Our story

We do whatever it takes to provide the best quality and experience in the industry, before, during and after your purchase.

A note from the owner

"We work for you. Please, do not hesitate to discuss as we specialize in giving you a better value, plus better quality, and lifetime warranty. We custom build to meet any specific price points, apples to apples, low price guarantee. Easy Rent-to-Own with our lowest rates."

Caleb Schlabach, Owner

A Classic experience

We work for you.

For most companies, warranties are carefully worded documents designed to legally protect them, not their customers. Instead of following standard industry practices, we decided to take responsibility for the long term, with a true lifetime warranty on all craftsmanship and materials.

If you aren't quite sure what you want or need, we'll help you figure it out without pressuring you into a sale. In fact, if we think you'll find a better fit elsewhere, we'll tell you. And when we deliver your shed, we'll make sure the building is set exactly where you want it before we leave.

Why choose Classic Shed Builders

  • Lifetime Warranty on vinyl & LP SmartSide
  • All 16" truss spacing with hurricane ties
  • Non-fade metal roof with underlayment
  • GAF shingle option
  • Magnetic door stops
  • Aluminum diamond plate in doorway
  • All the loft space you need
  • Techshield interior on deluxe series
  • Taller walls, proper roof pitch
  • Treated floor joists
  • Unique ramp designs
  • Delivery with the Mule at no charge
The Classic promise

Our promise to you

We take responsibility for the long term, with a true lifetime warranty on all craftsmanship and materials.

If you aren't quite sure what you want or need, we'll help you figure it out without pressuring you into a sale.

When we deliver your shed, we'll make sure the building is set exactly where you want it before we leave.

After your purchase and delivery, we'll stay in touch occasionally to make sure you are satisfied with your building.
